svg.text: Simple 8-bit Accumulator-based CPU · pin numbers are FPGA pins, as printed on the board · view from the top, USB at the top
Buttons: pin → 1 kΩ → button → GND (pressed reads 0)
7-segment on port C: pin → 1 kΩ → segment; common anode → 3.3 V
Port B is 1.8 V: never connect 3.3 V or 5 V parts directly
